items.canonicalEnglishName: Takuan pickled daikon (finely shredded, for garnish), a little
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Takuan pickled daikon (finely shredded, for garnish), a little' to USDA FNDDS 'Turnip, pickled'. The target is explicitly a pickled root vegetable and its own pinned evidence ranks this pickled-root record first. Confidence remains medium because daikon radish and turnip are different species and takuan curing, sugar, salt, water loss, and seasoning vary; this is a preparation-form nutritional proxy and does not imply botanical identity.
